title: Lay of the Land
description: When you **survey an environment or landscape away from your companions**, roll+INT, then skip ahead to when you return to your companions.

outcomes.text: Choose three benefits below. These last until you leave the environment or use this move again.
bullets: Natural wildlife won't prey on, or flee from, you or your allies
When you **Sneak Past** by blending in, treat a 7-9 as a 10+
When you **Unearth Secrets**, if the secret is related to the environment (e.g. corruption, feature, usual inhabitant, etc.), treat a 6- as a 7-9
When you **Undertake a Perilous Journey** as the leader, gain +1 to the roll and clear a Condition. If another PC is the leader, gain 1 Depth with them if they ask for your advice.

outcomes.text: Choose one, but something followed you back; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Hunter's Mark
description: Once per session, when you **focus on hunting an individual**, gain the following benefits when interacting with them until the end of that session:

bullets: Gain **adv** on Moves rolled in direct pursuit of them
When you **Spout Lore** about them, gain +1 to the roll
The first time this session you deal dmg to them, it's max
When you capture or defeat them, clear a Condition

title: Peerless Wayfarer
description: When you use **Lay of the Land**, if you spend excessive time exploring (days or weeks), make an extra choice. No matter the time spent, on a 12+, you also bring back a lead on an ally, opportunity, or treasure. Say which, then the GM will tell you more. When you leave an environment you've surveyed with **Lay of the Land**, write down your benefits; you regain them if you ever return here.

title: The Wild Provides
description: When you **search a natural landscape for resources**, **Defy Danger**+INT. On a 7+, gain 2 Uses, split between **adventuring gear**, **medicine**, and **provisions**.

title: Natural Historian
description: When you **Spout Lore** about flora or fauna from the wild, on a 7+, ask an additional question. If it can fight, the GM will also tell you its HP and dmg.
